tasks.command: Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Changeset instructions:' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '1. Up/Down moves through options.' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '2. Space selects or deselects the highlighted option.' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '3. Enter confirms each screen.' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '4. Select only the filters you changed.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '5. Leave major unchecked unless the change is breaking.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '6. For a minor release, select packages on the minor screen.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '7. For a patch release, leave major and minor empty, then select packages on the patch screen.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '8. Type a summary when prompted, then press Enter.' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '9. If Notepad opens, type the summary, save, and close Notepad.' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'After the summary, this task applies the version bumps automatically.' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; corepack pnpm changeset
tasks.label: Create Changeset

tasks.command: $pending = Get-ChildItem '.changeset' -Filter '*.md' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'README.md' }; if ($pending) { Write-Host 'Pending changesets found. Run Apply Version Bumps before publishing.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; corepack pnpm run release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push --follow-tags
tasks.label: Publish Release
Create Changeset and Apply Version Bumps
